item.title: Hudson’s Hope Health Centre temporarily closes again due to short staffing
item.description: The Hudson's Hope Health Centre has been closed temporarily on March 6th and will reopen on March 9th at 8.30 a.m.

item.title: Organizers of second Cultural Gathering of Nations seek sponsorship from Dawson Creek council
item.description: The organizers behind the Cultural Gathering of Nations at the Ovintiv Events Centre have sought sponsorship from the City of Dawson Creek.

item.title: Confirmed measles cases in northeast B.C. exceeds 320 in latest update
item.description: Two new confirmed measles cases have been reported by Northern Health in the week leading up to March 5th, both in the northeast region.

item.title: Energy regulator to funnel ‘significant funding and work’ into Peace orphan wells
item.description: During the PRRD’s February 26th board meeting, a delegation from the BC Energy Regulator (BCER) gave an update on plans for orphaned and dormant well sites in the Peace region.

item.title: Mother of B.C. mass shooting survivor shares update, says breathing tube removed
item.description: Maya Gebala had her breathing tube removed to see if she could breath on her own.

item.title: Clocks springing forward this weekend, B.C. adopts year-round daylight time
item.description: OTTAWA — Clocks are set to spring forward on Sunday as most of Canada moves to daylight time until the fall. item.title: Deadline extended for applications to design sculpture outside new Dawson Creek hospital
item.description: The deadline for expression of interests in designing a sculpture outside the new Dawson Creek and District Hospital has been extended from March 6th to March 27th. Artists who wish to apply must submit a resume and portfolio of past work.

item.title: Northern Lights College finds new location for Tumbler Ridge campus after tragedy
item.description: Northern Lights College (NLC) has found a new location for its Tumbler Ridge campus, after a mass shooting at its former home in the Tumbler Ridge Secondary School building.

item.title: Fifth person charged for 2022 double homicide in Penticton: RCMP
item.description: PENTICTON — The RCMP say a 36-year-old man has been charged with two counts of first-degree murder in connection with a 2022 double homicide in Penticton, B.C.
